domain_compliance.notes: Order (id, status, createdAt, items, customerId, totalAmount via getTotalAmount()), OrderItem (productId, quantity, unitPrice), Money (amount, currency, add/subtract/multiply), Address (street, city, zipCode, country), OrderStatus enum (PENDING, PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED). Exceptions: DomainException, InvalidOrderStateException, InvalidItemException, CurrencyMismatchException. Business rules: empty order rejected, total = sum(unitPrice*quantity), minimum 10 USD for PAID, positive quantity, non-negative unit price, cancellation only PENDING/PAID, ship only when PAID.

test_results.output_summary: BUILD SUCCESSFUL. All tests passed (AddressTest, MoneyTest, OrderItemTest, OrderTest).
